text:
taylor_sales: OrionBank returned the SIG; they want per-question evidence. I filled high-level answers but need attachments for Q12 (KMS), Q27 (audit logs), Q41 (pen test), Q58 (data residency). Who can pick these up?
priya_k: I can do KMS and short how-to for extracting key usage. Paste sheet link?
taylor_sales: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SALES/pages/ORION/SIG (tab ORION_SIG_2026)
nate_eng: I'll grab pen test redacted summary and SOC2 link. @engsec-bot drop artifacts please.
engsec-bot: Uploaded: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/orion/ORION_SIG_pentest-redacted.pdf, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/orion/ORION_SIG_soc2.pdf
leah_ops: For Q27: retention is 365d for prod, 90d for non-prod. Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/Log+Retention. Sample CloudWatch query:
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter service = "inference-runtime" and level = "ERROR"
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 25
```
priya_k: KMS note: Dedicated/Private support CMKs; hosted uses envelope encryption. Will upload policy and a short snippet. CLI to pull KMS events (pasteable):
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=GenerateDataKey --start-time 2026-01-01 --end-time 2026-03-31 > orion_kms_events.json
```
eva_legal: NDA status? Pen test full report is NDA-only. Has sales exchanged NDA?
taylor_sales: NDA sent yesterday; legal following up. We'll share redacted summary for now.
leah_ops: Q58 (data residency) note: for Dedicated we can pin region (eu-west-1) and store backups in customer VPC. Diagram: https://redwood.app/diagrams/orion-backups.png. Backup policy uploaded.
engsec-bot: Artifacts uploaded with prefix ORION_SIG_: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/orion/ORION_SIG_kms-policy.json, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/orion/ORION_SIG_log-retention.md, s3://redwood-sec-evidence/orion/ORION_SIG_backup-policy.md
nate_eng: Draft answers: Q12 "CMKs supported for Dedicated/Private; hosted uses envelope encryption (policy attached)." Q41 "Annual third-party pen test; redacted summary attached; full report available under NDA."
priya_k: I'll add a short README for how they can request key usage extracts and what fields we include.
taylor_sales: Please prefix uploads with ORION_SIG_. I'll attach to sheet and send to OrionBank by EOD. Thanks team :thumbsup:
engsec-bot: Reminder: mark NDA-only artifacts with [NDA_REQUIRED] in the sheet.
leah_ops: Left notes in the sheet about which artifacts are shareable vs NDA-only.
priya_k: Happy to run a 15m walkthrough with their security engineer if requested.
eva_legal: I'll confirm NDA status and update the thread.
